prepared_metadata.title: RankCloak Conceals the Surface Form of Synthetic Cryptographic Artifacts in Language Model Generated Text. Research code and data
prepared_metadata.description:
RankCloak research code and retained computational evidence for surface-form concealment of synthetic cryptographic artifacts in language-model-generated text. Version 3.0.0 contains the V4 author-review scientific snapshot and historical V1 through V3 materials. Manuscript and supplement sources, compiled PDFs, styles, bibliographies, figures, exact review correspondence, reviewer responses and cover letters are included.

The package includes generation and analysis code, frozen configurations and selections, raw and derived data, both unsuccessful semantic control-only pilots, execution and test records, reproducibility instructions, model acquisition identities and hashes, and license notices. It retains the six strict-gate failure diagnostics, exploratory local conditional-likelihood study, bounded transport diagnostics, configuration compatibility check and directional fixed-message Q4-to-Q8 byte reconstruction.

Neither semantic pilot met its prospective control-separation criterion. Conditional context gain passed its specified control-separation check and supports only limited local conditional compatibility under the retained scoring contract. Ordinary controls were sampled and RankCloak continuations were greedy. Semantic coherence and reader-perceived naturalness were not established. The results do not establish cryptographic confidentiality, statistical indistinguishability or general transport robustness. The complete written response to Reviewer 1 comment 4 has partial empirical coverage. No participant judgments were collected, and this release makes no claim of journal submission or acceptance.

The immutable scientific source is Git commit 7f48ae2ef2fb11201ffe7a5a14c1568a9811b4e0, tree bcea80173eea5c98bcf588642f58e70edd42c573. The archived internal candidate label is 3.0.0-rc1. The public release version is 3.0.0. The original candidate ZIP is unchanged. Its SHA256 is 1aca84b5dd45208f14b93ff88cc4c18ac7af2c8c485468b5373a38ba1620b625. The JSON and CSV manifests list all 8,856 payload files, including ARCHIVE_SOURCE.json. The checksum companion covers the ZIP and JSON manifest. Later administrative handoff records and DOI-updated submission documents are not inside this ZIP. Availability statements inside the historical snapshot describe the state at assembly.

Pretrained model weights, virtual environments, credentials, caches, incidental build intermediates, nested historical ZIP bundles and downloaded third-party source or paper snapshots are excluded. Primary-source URLs, revisions and checksums remain. The public synthetic artifacts are not operational credentials. The repository code uses the MIT license. Third-party materials retain their own terms as documented in release/v4/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICE.md, including the Dolly control subset under CC BY-SA 3.0, template notices and manuscript/review material that is not relicensed as MIT code. Model licenses apply on separate acquisition.

This version belongs under concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21987449. Historical version 2.0.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22555497, covers V3. This description explicitly includes the manuscript materials and corrects the older record's contradictory manuscript-exclusion description. Source and later administrative updates are available in the repository. The packaged offline reproduction instructions identify portable inputs and distinguish historical machine paths from runtime requirements.
